UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private player profile with custom nickname and compressed avatar data.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

avatarData.description: Preset path, Google photo URL, or compressed JPEG/WebP data URL.

avatarKind.description: Source type of the profile picture.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

SavedServer.title: SavedServer
SavedServer.description: A user-saved Minecraft-style multiplayer server entry.

id.description: Document ID matching the saved server entry.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who saved this server.

name.description: Custom display name for the server (1-32 characters).

lastPlayedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of when the user last joined this server.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the server was added.

PlayHistoryEntry.title: PlayHistoryEntry
PlayHistoryEntry.description: A record of a server or direct-connect room the user played in.

id.description: Document ID matching the history entry.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

serverName.description: Optional display name if joined from saved servers; empty for direct connect.

directConnect.description: True when joined via direct connect without saving to server list.

playedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the session was joined.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this history record was stored.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile document containing nickname and custom avatar.

/users/{userId}/servers/{serverId}.description: Owner-only subcollection of saved multiplayer servers.

/users/{userId}/history/{historyId}.description: Owner-only subcollection of multiplayer play history including direct connections.
